info.title: Zero Networks
info.description: Zero Networks is a microsegmentation and network security platform that automates identity- and network-based access controls, enforcing least-privilege segmentation policies across on-premises, cloud, and OT/IoT assets without manual rule authoring.
info.x-itential-curated: Reviewed against the repo's common-CRUD-for-automation policy: of the upstream spec's 1596 listed paths, only 40 operations across 20 paths are actually defined (the rest are unimplemented path stubs with no operation bodies). All 40 defined operations are already common CRUD for automation — network policy rules (inbound/outbound), reactive policies, AE exclusions, internal access policies, RPC rules, custom groups, and asset lookup — so the full set of usable operations is carried through as -latest. See the repo README for the operation breakdown and the full spec.
